Secure Franklin Community Membership

Activate membership for the right Franklin profile.

Create or sign in to your Franklin account, connect the exact business or organization profile, complete authority verification, then continue to Stripe. A payment is never accepted before Franklin can attach membership to the verified profile.

Three choices
  • $5 monthly
  • $50 annually
  • $120 once for 36 months — no automatic renewal
Checking secure Franklin membership service…

Why profile verification comes first

Franklin Navigator will not infer a business or organization from a payer name or email. The exact profile must be linked and verified before checkout opens.

After payment

Stripe sends the payment event to Franklin’s membership service. The site then records the durable membership and entitlement and shows your membership status and billing controls.
